"Things like that happen," I thought at the time. But—

...Talking to her like this, she didn't appear to have any problems.
Despite some post-race fatigue, her demeanor was entirely normal.

...You are quite meticulous in your evaluations.
That checklist appears to be exceptionally thorough as well.

I am relieved to hear it.
Thanks to you, I have gained even greater confidence in my current management approach.

And when that happens countless times over,
you inevitably find your eyes drawn to them—

Training routines, lifestyle habits like diet and sleep, equipment condition,
environmental factors—it was an overwhelming amount of information for an individual to track—

Everything was recorded in meticulous daily detail,
down to precise response protocols for any fluctuations in each parameter.

However, injuries can lurk beneath the surface where they can't be seen.
Brushing it off because "she seems fine" would be dangerous.

...So, what is the verdict?
Are there any apparent abnormalities with my condition?

...Seeing the same Umamusume running in consecutive
mock races isn't necessarily that unusual on its own.
—For as long as the Umamusume themselves desire to run.

Using my homemade checklist, I requested a thorough check
to ensure there were no misalignments in her joint positioning—

Her health seems to be in excellent shape.
From an internal medicine perspective, there appear to be no abnormalities.

Having run in so many mock races,
Ikuno Dictus's lower legs had to be bearing substantial fatigue.

If she was pushing herself through back-to-back races,
she risked sustaining an injury that could prove career-ending...!

Ever since enrollment.
I keep comprehensive records, if you would care to review them?

Yes. Managing mind and body so as not to disrupt my condition,
competing in as many races as possible without setbacks, and fulfilling my "goal"—

An Umamusume gives her absolute all during a race. Seeing them run
reminded me just how clearly their strengths and physical vulnerabilities emerge on the track.

...I see. So that is why you went out of your way to approach me.
I truly appreciate your concern.
That was the name I had seen time and time again on the race cards up until today.

Well then—thank you very much for conducting such a comprehensive examination today.
If you will excuse me.
I'm not losing...! Haaaaaaagh!!!
And... to let them run in full health.

For a rookie trainer like me,
it was a crucial gathering ground for scouting future trainees.

There was not a flicker of hesitation in her eyes as she spoke.
All that shone within them was an unyielding—iron-clad resolve.

I could see clear evidence of her relentless effort,
constantly updating tracking metrics to refine management precision...!
An examination? That is...—

At this rate, I wanted to learn about as many Umamusume as possible.
I resolved to watch mock races whenever I had free time, and—

I spotted her again in another race.
Once it happens two or three times, however, that's a different story.
—Yes.

Even if called "mock" races, they are run under actual race conditions. The fatigue should be immense.
Yet she continued to run without taking any real breaks in between...—

To be frank, I could hardly believe it. Her body was remarkably stable—
so much so that you would never guess she was racing at an unprecedented frequency.

That is the purpose of self-management. ...Leading up to today's race,
this is how I maintained my physical condition.
I see...! This is very educational.

Running more than anyone else and using that experience to grow stronger. ...I believe
that is the training required to achieve the "goal" that only I can fulfill.

...Mock races are held daily at Tracen Academy.
For pre-debut Umamusume, they serve as invaluable opportunities for live race experience—

...Looking back, Ikuno Dictus had participated
in almost every single mock race I had watched recently.
—Yes. Is something the matter?

—Before I knew it,
I found myself following Ikuno Dictus as she left the infirmary.

——... The timing of my spurt has improved.
The remaining issues are my positioning immediately before making a move, and—

—I misjudged the timing to shift into top speed.
...No, before that, I hadn't properly conserved my stamina. In that case—
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...! Nngh...!!

Taking up her offer, I examined the logs stored on her device.
There, spanning from her enrollment to this very day, were logs without a single day missing—

I had decided on the day I passed through the gates of Tracen Academy.
What kind of trainer I wanted to be—

—I was left in pure astonishment. Her self-management methodology, theoretical framework,
and the mental fortitude to execute it far surpassed the level of a student...!

Yes. Currently, I adjust my training and lifestyle parameters
under the operational premise of competing in consecutive mock races.
Looking at the "management data" presented by Ikuno Dictus, I was left speechless.
—Understood. In that case, I shall undergo the examination right away.

—Afterward, I asked the infirmary doctor
to conduct an examination on Ikuno Dictus.

...A few days later.
At another mock race.
—Alright, just you watch...!
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...—
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...—

And so, I stood frozen in place
until Ikuno Dictus's purposeful figure faded into the distance—
